title: A request without a supported goal returns needs_input
notice: Synthetic and illustrative. Card names, facts, identifiers and field names are invented for this example. The live server's advertised schemas are authoritative.
demonstrates: The assistant explains request history before the first Rewardopedia call.
The assistant does not guess a goal from prose.
needs_input is a distinct outcome with follow-up questions.

steps.text: Before I use Rewardopedia: it keeps a sanitized history of each Rewardopedia request, including searches and comparisons, in your Rewardopedia account until you delete it. It saves facts you tell me, such as cards you hold, but I won't save anything you ask me not to. Both are shared across assistants connected to your account, and you can ask what is saved or ask me to forget it at any time.

followUpQuestions: Which goal matters most: cash back, travel rewards, dining, groceries, gas, hotel loyalty, airline loyalty or business spending?
Is there a maximum annual fee you would accept?

steps.text: There is no single best card; it depends on what you want. Which goal matters most to you: cash back, travel rewards, dining, groceries, gas, hotel loyalty, airline loyalty or business spending? And is there a maximum annual fee you would accept?
